summary: Collective Mining Ltd. filed a Form 6-K containing a September 1, 2026 press release announcing assay results from ten diamond drill holes at its Guayabales Project in Colombia. The release reports a new high-grade extension to the Apollo breccia, including 141.40m at 4.88 g/t AuEq in APC172-D2. This is a routine exploration update by a mining issuer, not a special-situation corporate event. No transaction, tender, restructuring, or activist activity is involved. The filing is purely operational disclosure with no deal terms or strategic actions.
